release: Operator, Claude chat 2026-11-16: "Release all three", including one Z0 zero-paid Zed session. The operator typed each prompt; Claude launched and quit Zed, picked the agent, checked the probe log after every prompt before the next, and captured screenshots.

agent.entry: optimus-p1211-z0, a custom agent server added to Zed's settings for this session and removed after it (settings restored byte-identical from a backup)
agent.outbound_path: Notices built by optimus.acp.memory_notices from synthetic MemoryNotice records and written by optimus.acp.server.StdioNdjsonLineWriter, the host's own NDJSON writer
agent.evidence_of_zero_calls: No Gateway, Optimus agent or model ran: process listings during the session showed only the probe, and nothing listened on 8765 or 8776. The probe's code opens no socket of its own; tests/unit/acp/test_memory_notices.py runs it under an audit hook that refuses name lookups and any connection outside its own event-loop pipe.

prompts.gate: probe log recorded the prompt and its result before the next prompt was released

prompts.note: after the address fix; Zed was quit and relaunched because it runs one agent process for all threads

P5-b.pre_prompt_text: SHOWN. An agent_message_chunk sent right after the session/new response renders before any prompt (01-pre-prompt-brief.jpg). Optional surface under D4; nothing may depend on it.
P5-b.first_response_brief: SHOWN. The brief leads the first response with its citation (02-first-response-cards-and-fallback.jpg).
P5-b.welcome_command: SHOWN. /welcome, advertised through available_commands_update after session/new, returns the brief (03-welcome.jpg).
P5-b.selected_surface: First-response brief plus /welcome, as the plan states.

P5-c.model_free_card: SHOWN. A tool_call with id memory/<event_id>, kind other, renders as a card; status failed adds a red mark (02, 04).
P5-c.same_id_resend: ONE CARD. The same tool_call id and state sent twice renders once (05-update-resend-forget.jpg), so a reconnect resend is safe.
P5-c.appended_text_fallback: SHOWN. The appended block quote renders after the answer (02, 05).
P5-c.unconfirmed_wording: SHOWN. An unconfirmed save says 'Not saved yet' and is marked failed; it never says Remembered.
P5-c.selected_surface: Card, with the appended text as the fallback for clients without cards.

label_rendering.markdown: Card titles and message text render Markdown. Escaped emphasis, links, code, HTML and headings show as literal characters.
label_rendering.controls_and_bidi: Removed before display; the right-to-left override did not reorder the label.
label_rendering.autolink_finding: Zed auto-linked a bare http://x inside an escaped label in both surfaces (02). Fixed in memory_notices.escape_label: addresses render as http[:]//x and www[.]name. Rechecked in Zed after the fix: plain text, not a link (04-address-inert-after-fix.jpg).
label_rendering.session_resume: On relaunch Zed tried to resume the earlier thread and reported 'Loading or resuming sessions is not supported by this agent', as the probe advertises loadSession false.

observations.P5-d: NOT CLAIMED. Nothing here says what Zed keeps in its history or logs.
